name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: Light and dark theme switch with six distinct icon animations: rotate, morph, flip, slide, eclipse, and spring.

props.name: animation
props.description: Icon animation, played on click with the Web Animations API (transform and opacity only, 650ms).

props.name: size
props.description: Size 32, 40, or 48px, the same heights as Button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme in React and Vue: the parent saves it and handles clicks. Blade applies it once on load.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key that keeps the choice.

props.name: showText
props.description: Shows the label as visible text next to the icon. Pair it with short labels such as Dark mode.

props.name: lightLabel
props.description: Name while the dark theme is on. Visible text with showText.

props.name: darkLabel
props.description: Name while the light theme is on. Visible text with showText.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: React callback after a click. Vue emits change. Every version also dispatches markas-theme-change on document.

props.name: themeChange
props.description: Angular only. Emits the theme a click asked for. Svelte uses onThemeChange.

a11y: A native button element, so Enter and Space work and focus shows a 2px primary outline.
The name says the action, Switch to dark theme or Switch to light theme, and follows the button data-state.
The icon is aria-hidden, so screen readers only hear the label.
With prefers-reduced-motion the icon swaps at once, without animation.

ai.whenToUse: A light and dark switch in a site header, settings page, or app shell that uses the dark class from markas.css.
rules: Use one storageKey for the whole site so every toggle and the head script agree
Set the dark class in a small head script before paint to avoid a flash of the wrong theme
Pick one animation per site and keep it the same in every toggle

id.description: Tombol ganti tema terang dan gelap dengan enam animasi ikon yang berbeda: rotate, morph, flip, slide, eclipse, dan spring.

props.animation: Animasi ikon, diputar saat klik lewat Web Animations API (hanya transform dan opacity, 650ms).
props.size: Ukuran 32, 40, atau 48px, sama dengan tinggi Button.
props.theme: Tema terkontrol di React dan Vue: induk yang menyimpan dan menangani klik. Blade menerapkannya sekali saat dimuat.
props.showText: Menampilkan label sebagai teks di samping ikon. Pakai label pendek seperti Mode gelap.
props.lightLabel: Nama tombol saat tema gelap aktif. Menjadi teks terlihat dengan showText.
props.darkLabel: Nama tombol saat tema terang aktif. Menjadi teks terlihat dengan showText.
props.onThemeChange: Callback React setelah klik. Vue memancarkan change. Semua versi juga mengirim markas-theme-change di document.
props.themeChange: Khusus Angular. Memancarkan tema yang diminta klik. Svelte memakai onThemeChange.

a11y: Elemen button native, jadi Enter dan Spasi berfungsi dan fokus tampil sebagai outline 2px warna primary.
Nama tombol menyebut aksinya, Switch to dark theme atau Switch to light theme, dan mengikuti data-state tombol.
Ikon aria-hidden, jadi screen reader hanya mendengar label.
Dengan prefers-reduced-motion ikon langsung berganti tanpa animasi.

ai.whenToUse: Tombol terang dan gelap di header situs, halaman pengaturan, atau kerangka aplikasi yang memakai class dark dari markas.css.
rules: Pakai satu storageKey untuk seluruh situs agar semua toggle dan script head sepakat
Pasang class dark lewat script kecil di head sebelum paint agar tidak berkedip tema yang salah
Pilih satu animasi per situs dan pakai sama di setiap toggle
